name: National Weather Service API (weather.gov)
summary: Official US forecasts, hourly forecasts, alerts, observations and station data.
description: Gridpoint forecasts (12-hour periods and hourly), active watches, warnings and advisories, latest station observations, zone and office metadata, and radar stations for the United States and territories. Responses are JSON-LD or GeoJSON.

auth.notes: No key; a descriptive User-Agent header is required.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Descriptive User-Agent identifying your app; requests without one may be blocked.

rate_limit.summary: Not published numerically; described as generous. Exceeding it returns 429 after a retry window of about 5 seconds.

endpoints.summary: Resolve grid, forecast URLs and zone for a point

agent_notes: Two-step flow: call /points/{lat},{lon} first to get the office and grid x,y, then request the forecast for that gridpoint. Always send a descriptive User-Agent. US only.
caveats: Requests without a User-Agent may be blocked.
Verified /points and /gridpoints forecast; other endpoints per docs.
Forecasts update roughly hourly, alerts in real time, observations about hourly.
